svg.title: GTOpen value-net training data: 386,801 training examples from 4 contributors
svg.desc: Cumulative validated examples over time. Go/no-go check at 50,000, goal 300,000. 128.9% of goal. Stage 1, from Nov 6: Random ranges in a first set of games. Data for the first check and for leaf nets v1 and v2.. Stage 2, from Nov 16: Random ranges in common live and online games (game mix 1). Data for leaf net v3, the learned flop values Preflop Lab uses today: live rake, straddles, deep stacks.. Stage 3, from Nov 21: Game mix 2: half as mix 1, half spots from our own preflop solves. Data for leaf net v4: what the hands just outside each range are worth, so calling ranges come out right.. Stage 4, from Nov 23: Game mix 3: as mix 2, with big cards handed the big spots. The same data as mix 2. Cards of 24 GB and more leave most small spots to smaller cards.. Stage 5, from Nov 26: Game mix 4: three-player flops. What a flop is worth with three players in the hand, which Preflop Lab only estimates today..
svg.text: What the pool solves, and what it is for
From Nov 6: Random ranges in a first set of games
Data for the first check and for leaf nets v1 and v2.
From Nov 16: Random ranges in common live and online games (game mix 1)
Data for leaf net v3, the learned flop values Preflop Lab uses today: live rake, straddles, deep stacks.
From Nov 21: Game mix 2: half as mix 1, half spots from our own preflop solves
Data for leaf net v4: what the hands just outside each range are worth, so calling ranges come out right.
15,000 of 15,000 of these spots solved · target reached
From Nov 23: Game mix 3: as mix 2, with big cards handed the big spots
The same data as mix 2. Cards of 24 GB and more leave most small spots to smaller cards.
From Nov 26: Game mix 4: three-player flops
What a flop is worth with three players in the hand, which Preflop Lab only estimates today.
Games by GPU memory needed: under 6 GB 86% · 6 to 12 GB 7% · 12 to 19 GB 5% · over 19 GB 2% (of 56,310 that record it)
